about_the_game:
Nighthawk is a horror adventure game based in an early twentieth century mining town that was abandoned and scrapped after it stopped bringing in enough money for the company that owned it, or so it seems...

  • EMPHASIS ON EXPLORATION 

To survive in Nighthawk you need to use your resources wisely... Make sure to scout every area you pass through along your journey to collect resources and other useful items!

  • STORYTELLING 

Drop yourself into this games immersive story created by BainMeetsWorld and find out what really happened to the people of Nighthawk and how it all links to the company responsible for the mine in the first place, GEL&PC. While also uncovering the dark and malicious secrets surrounding the people themselves.

  • GAMEPLAY MECHANICS 

With gameplay heavily inspired by recent first-person horror titles, we decided to mix that gameplay style with the nostalgic gameplay of a point and click adventure game!

  • ADVANCED ENEMY AI + FEAR SYSTEM 

The Enemies in this game will respond to how scared the player is by becoming more aggressive and erratic the more scared of them you are! You have to find a way to stay calm and try not to alert the enemies of your presence...

The fear system will limit your ability when you are too scared, blurring your vision and destabilizing your character, be careful!

NO GENERATIVE AI WAS USED TO MAKE ANY OF THE ART and/or ASSETS IN THIS GAME.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 9600 or AMD Ryzen 5 3500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Not final, testing needs to be done, this is just a very rough estimate.

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 12600 or AMD Ryzen 5600X
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 1080 or AMD RX 5700XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
